hooks.command: notify-send "Claude Code" "Claude Code finished" 2>/dev/null || osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code finished" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null; pw-play "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || paplay "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || afplay "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || true

notify-send "Claude Code" "Waiting for your input" 2>/dev/null || osascript -e 'display notification "Waiting for your input" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null; pw-play "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || paplay "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || afplay "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/sounds/bruh_meme.mp3" 2>/dev/null || true
